summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to study the effectiveness of home cardiorespiratory monitors for infants in preventing sudden unexpected infant death and to report the findings, including recommendations for insurance coverage, to Congress within one year.

scores.thoughts: This bill directs the Secretary of Health and Human Services to study and report on home cardiorespiratory monitors for infants, including recommendations for coverage under public or private health insurance plans. This directly relates to healthcare services and coverage, aiming to improve infant health outcomes.
